items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: And Nellie Lutcher was playing piano. She played piano, that's that band the neighborhood, Lutcher's.

ctx.x: Do you remember anybody else in that band? Oh no. Anyone like Lawrence Dewey or Clarence?

No, Skinner, I mean I used to play bass. His name was Skinner, that's Nellie Lutcher's daddy. Oh yes. Oh, Lutcher then. Yes, Skinner Lutcher. That's right, I remember hearing that. And Nellie Lutcher was playing piano. She played piano, that's that band the neighborhood, Lutcher's.
